ranking_policy: Self-improving agent harness scan. The harness is the software around a frozen foundation model that mediates how it observes, reasons, and acts: its prompts, tools, memory, skills, sub-agents, verifiers, routing, and control flow. Rank 2026 papers by how directly their technique lets an agent improve that harness (or adapt online within a single run) rather than retrain the model: agents that refine their own prompts, tools, skills, memory, verifiers, workflow/topology, or routing rank highest; verifier-gated self-modification, process-reward/co-learning loops, experience/trajectory reuse, skill libraries, self-play curricula, and online/test-time adaptation rank high; components such loops depend on (reward models, verifiers, memory stores, routers, evaluators) rank medium; model-only training with no harness/online-adaptation story ranks low. Papers matched by multiple topics rank above single-topic matches; break ties by citation signal and recency. Anchored on arXiv:2605.09998 (Continual Harness).
